-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /page Page(ctx)" -}}
<button data-on:click="{{ .Actions.Show .Result | .JS }}">hostile</button>
<a data-on:click="{{ .Actions.Toggle 42 true | .JS }}">bare</a>
{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /records/{slug} Show(ctx, slug)" -}}{{ .Result }}{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /toggle/{id}/{on} Toggle(ctx, id, on)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --

-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Slug implements encoding.TextMarshaler with hostile output: attacker
// influence can flow through marshaled types too, so they get the same
// two-layer sanitization as plain strings.
type Slug struct{}

func (Slug) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte("</script>'\"<&?/x"), nil
}

func (Slug) UnmarshalText([]byte) error { return nil }

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Page(_ context.Context) (Slug, error) { return Slug{}, nil }

func (Server) Show(_ context.Context, slug Slug) (string, error) { return "ok", nil }

// Toggle pins that int and bool parameters render bare, with no quoting
// artifacts.
func (Server) Toggle(_ context.Context, id int, on bool) (string, error) { return "ok", nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/page", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	for _, hostile := range []string{`</script>`, `'"`, `<&`, `?/x`} {
		if strings.Contains(body, hostile) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q contains the raw hostile substring %q", body, hostile)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(body, "/records/%3C%2Fscript%3E") {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the marshaled slug percent-encoded into a single segment", body)
	}
	if want := `data-on:click="@get(&#39;/toggle/42/true&#39;)"`; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want bare int and bool segments %q", body, want)
	}
}
